title: Incandescent Manipulations
subtitle: Lux - blood remembers light
text: The Incandescent temper belongs to blood that has witnessed things that glow. Hematic Flare (QUICK) strikes the creature you aim at with a short Lux ray and Illuminates it, and held it is a searchlight: a beam that Illuminates and outlines whatever it passes over, builds heat on a body it rests on, and flashes at a click. Prismatic Reproof (QUICK) projects a cone of Lux that strikes Illuminated targets twice as hard. Hematic Beacon (QUICK) raises an aimed rally zone that mends allies and Illuminates the enemies inside it. Sculpting, Projection: held on a surface it spreads thin lines of light that fade over four minutes. Lumen Suture (QUICK) sutures the nearest wounded ally with light. Radiant Wake (CONTINUOUS) holds you aloft in a glide and mends you and your allies. White Verdict (CHARGED) fires a piercing beam that grows with its charge. Unclosing Eye (QUICK) is Seraphae's Canon Memory and strips the concealment round you. Conjure Spear reshapes a held Living Staff into a Living Spear.
